title: Leap Year Checker
description: Check whether a year is a leap year under Gregorian rules and see the next and previous leap years. The check runs in your browser.
intro: Enter a year to see if February has 29 days, why the rule matched, and the nearest leap years on either side.
blurb: Test any year against the Gregorian leap-year rule and list nearby leap years.
howItWorks: Press Check year. A year is a leap year when it is divisible by 4, except century years, which must be divisible by 400.
Read the verdict plus the previous and next leap years.
examples: 2024 is a leap year because it is divisible by 4.
1900 is not a leap year because it is a century not divisible by 400.
2000 is a leap year because it is divisible by 400.

faq.a: The proleptic Gregorian rule: divisible by 4, but not by 100 unless also divisible by 400. Julian-only calendars are not applied.
